access.note: Pay & Display lot off Route 8 (about 3 mi south of US 50), entered via Marine Academy Dr. $2.50 per hour per vehicle, credit card only since October 2025. Print the receipt and display it face-up, or get a $50 citation. The ramp lot needs a QAC Landing Permit. The lot can fill in peak season; overflow parking is a short walk away.

rules.text: Chesapeake Bay and tidal tributaries (MD), excluding Susquehanna Flats, Lower Susquehanna River and Northeast River: harvest 05-01–05-15 19-24 in 1 per person per day; 05-16–05-31 19-24 in 1 per person per day
Striped bass: Chesapeake Bay rules, closed to targeting all of August
Matapeake is not in a listed spawning river
License: Maryland Chesapeake Bay & Coastal Sport Fishing License (Matt states he holds a MD tidal license; not verified) (per Matt; not verified)

rig.primary: 3/8-1/2 oz round jighead (3/0-4/0), 4-5 in white or chartreuse paddletail, 24-30 in 30 lb fluoro tied direct to 20 lb braid (FG knot)
rig.alternate: 4-5 in white or bone popper or walk-the-dog plug (~1/2-3/4 oz), loop knot to 24 in 30 lb fluoro
rig.switch_trigger: Low light, flat calm, fish or bait busting on top in under 10 ft of water
rig.gear_note: Fits Matt's 7 ft Daiwa Crossfire Inshore MH with 20 lb braid and 30 lb leader; he owns 1/4-3/8 oz jigheads and 4 in paddletails. Buy 1/2-3/4 oz heads for inlet/bridge current

rules.text: Nontidal waters (MD), statewide: harvest 01-01–12-31 15 in minimum 5 per day / 10 possession
Potomac River mainstem, nontidal (MD): harvest 01-01–04-15 15-20 in slot 5 per day / 10 possession; 04-16–12-31 15 in minimum 5 per day / 10 possession
Maryland-Virginia boundary is the low-water mark on the Virginia shore; Maryland owns the riverbed (Black-Jenkins award 1877). Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Virginia_v._Maryland

NPS: Maryland license required for 16+ in nontidal waters; regs follow the state where you fish. Fishing from the Virginia bank would be a separate question. Source: https://www.nps.gov/choh/planyourvisit/fishing.htm
License: Maryland nontidal license (Matt's stated license; not verified here) (per Matt; not verified)

rig.primary: 3/8 oz round jighead (2/0) with 3.5-4 in white or chartreuse paddletail/grub, 20 lb braid to 3 ft 12 lb fluoro
rig.alternate: Suspending jerkbait 4.5 in (silver/black or clown) or small shallow crankbait, 20 lb braid to 3 ft 12 lb fluoro, #1 round snap
rig.switch_trigger: Snagging every cast in rock, or fish seen chasing near the surface at dusk
rig.gear_note: Workable on Matt's 7 ft Crossfire MH (20 lb braid) with the leader dropped to 10-12 lb; ideal is a 6'6"-7' medium spinning rod with 10 lb braid. The unconfirmed 6'6" Ugly Stik fits if the 17 lb leader is swapped lighter.
